Senior Backend Engineer - Payments Platform (fictional posting for tests)
Company: Ledgerly (Bengaluru, hybrid)

About the role
You will design and scale the services that move money for millions of users. You will own
APIs end to end, from design to on-call, and work closely with product and data teams.

Responsibilities
- Design, build and operate high-throughput microservices for payment processing
- Build and maintain RESTful APIs consumed by web and mobile clients
- Optimise database performance and data models for transactional workloads
- Improve CI/CD pipelines and release reliability
- Mentor junior engineers and review code

Requirements
- 3+ years of professional backend development experience
- Strong Python; experience with FastAPI or Django
- Solid SQL skills and experience with PostgreSQL
- Experience building REST APIs
- Docker and Kubernetes in production
- Event streaming with Apache Kafka
- Cloud experience, preferably AWS

Nice to have
- Redis or other caching layers
- Go
- Terraform / infrastructure as code
- Experience in fintech or payments
